rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to the account and reviewed the correct pending order. It correctly determined the 4-foot glass/white variant was unavailable and presented available alternatives. When the user requested cancellation with the stated reason, the agent proceeded to cancel the pending order and the tool confirms status changed to cancelled with a refund to the same gift card. However, policy requires the agent to explicitly restate the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before performing any order-changing write. The agent executed the cancellation without that confirmation step, which violates the policy. Final information about the refund appears supported by the tool logs. The missing confirmation step causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
